summary.overview: The repository builds unusually honest, mechanical CI self-audits, but the highest-churn web path lands on main with no commit-time check, heavy native/device gates fire only on a stale branch or manual dispatch, and reviewed sessions closed edits without any validation. Credential handling and a documented-but-inactive local secret scan leave the permission boundary partly unenforced.

dimensions.label: Task Understanding
dimensions.summary: Rich architecture, decision, and worklog documents exist as the context trail, but no reviewed episode showed them steering the change, and episode scope signals stayed partial.

dimensions.label: Controlled Execution
dimensions.summary: Manifests, scripts, and a Make work surface are present and partly wired, but the enforced permission boundary shows two confirmed defects: a credential handoff through chat and an inactive declared secret scan.

dimensions.label: Change Validation
dimensions.summary: Push-triggered gates genuinely cover the iOS and Android benchmark paths, yet the most-changed web core (src/**) has no commit-time check that exercises its behavior.

dimensions.label: Reliable Delivery
dimensions.summary: Work is delivered by direct commits to main with no PR or merge-gate decision bound to the revision; external protection could not be observed and is not claimed absent.

dimensions.label: Learning Capture
dimensions.summary: A bounded review completed, but 36 of 39 admitted episodes lacked a recoverable request boundary, so recurrence is undecidable; project Skills under native/skills remain routing leads only, with no use or outcome evidence.

findings.title: Web app changes reach main with no commit-time validation
findings.reason: Fact: src/** is the most-churned surface and lands via direct commits to main, but the only workflow referencing src/** (eval-gate.yml) triggers on pull_request, schedule, and manual dispatch — no push — and its PR leg never fires because the repo has zero merge-PR commits. No workflow anywhere runs next build, eslint, or tsc. Consequence: a TypeScript or build regression on the web core stays undetected until the 02:30 UTC scheduled run at the earliest, and the live eval leg is designed to report NEUTRAL when the origin is down. The project's own trigger self-audit (check_workflow_trigger_covers_scripts.py) deliberately scopes only workflows that run .github/scripts/*, so it cannot flag this gap. Owner: .github/workflows plus package.json script surface. Uncertainty: conclusions are trigger-config and git-topology based; Actions run history was not inspected.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Gate owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Web app changes reach main with no commit-time validation. Add the smallest GitHub Actions workflow that triggers on push to main for paths src/**, package.json, and next.config.ts, running only commands already declared in package.json: bun run lint and bun run build. Before wiring any test step, first discover whether an executable web unit route exists among the existing package.json scripts; do not invent one.

## Validation

- Push a touch to src/** on a branch with the workflow and confirm it starts without adding failures the current tree does not already have
- Confirm the new workflow does not duplicate eval-gate scheduled legs

## Scope

CI configuration only. Keep the existing honest-verdict conventions of eval-gate unchanged; no product-code edits.

findings.title: Reviewed sessions close edits without running any relevant check
findings.reason: Fact: in the Qoder session lane (provider-labelled), all three emitted Task Episodes ended with closure changed-without-check — a project change with zero validation events, no result signal, and no reviewed relevant check; one episode carried a high-confidence testing-verification lifecycle demand that was never fulfilled. Independent corroboration from the analyzer lane: 40 edit events with no later validation command in the analyzed sample. Consequence: edited work is handed back unverified, compounding the missing commit-time gate. Confidence: moderate — the emitted episodes cover 3 of 39 admitted episodes (36 lacked a request boundary), so this cannot be generalized to the full population. Falsifier: the unobserved episodes contain reviewed relevant checks.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Rule owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Reviewed sessions close edits without running any relevant check. Choose one durable, project-owned home (for example, a project instructions file alongside docs/) and record the smallest convention: after any edit to src/**, run the check that covers the edit from the already-declared package.json routes (bun run lint; bun run test:widgets for widget compiler changes). State when each check applies and what a failure means. Do not add new tooling or prescribe provider-specific syntax that was not discovered in this repository.

## Validation

- Make one small src edit and confirm the named check runs afterward and its result is retained
- Re-run a bounded session review and confirm later comparable episodes show a check after the change

## Scope

Convention documentation only; no CI or product-code changes.

findings.title: Heavy native and device suites fire only on a stale branch or manual trigger
findings.reason: Fact: ios-native.yml, android-app.yml, android-native.yml, and android-deps.yml trigger on push to native-runtime, whose tip is 325 commits behind main; smooth-check, android-device, android-screens, and baseline-profile are workflow_dispatch-only, which the project's own lint script calls out as 'a manual run is not a gate'. android-benchmark.yml does fire on main for android/app and android/benchmark paths, and iOS builds run on main for ios/** paths. Consequence: the largest instrumented and device verification suites never exercise current-main code unless a person triggers them, so native/device regressions can sit undetected. Uncertainty: this may be a deliberate cost trade-off (android-deps.yml notes these builds are long); Actions run history was not inspected; the full instrumented-suite routing was not traced.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Workflow owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Heavy native and device suites fire only on a stale branch or manual trigger. First, bounded discovery: trace which workflow actually executes the Android instrumented suites (android/app androidTest targets) and the iOS test bundle for current-main commits, and record the answer in docs. Then either sync native-runtime forward (git branch management, current tip is 325 behind main) so its gates see current code, or move the smallest high-value suite's push trigger onto the main paths it protects. Decide and record the intended cadence rather than leaving it implicit.

## Validation

- Confirm one native/device gate runs to completion on a revision of main
- Confirm the recorded cadence decision is visible next to the workflows it governs

## Scope

Workflow triggers and branch sync only; no suite content changes.

findings.title: The declared secret-scan pre-commit hook does not run in the current working copy
findings.reason: Fact: .githooks/pre-commit scans staged diffs for API-key shapes and worklog.md asserts it is 'wired via core.hooksPath; live-tested', but in this clone git config core.hooksPath is unset and .git/hooks contains no installed hook, and no tracked file performs the wiring. Consequence: a commit made in this working copy bypasses the local secret scan the project documents as enforced. Confidence: medium — core.hooksPath is per-clone and never version-controlled, so this is the current state, likely lost on re-clone (corrupt-repo and db:reset history in the worklog suggest re-clones); GitHub push-protection is a separate server-side backstop the hook comment itself cites.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Hook owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

The declared secret-scan pre-commit hook does not run in the current working copy. Run git config core.hooksPath .githooks in this repository, and add the same one-line wiring to the project-owned setup route (Makefile or .zscripts) so re-clones restore it automatically. Do not modify the hook's scan patterns.

## Validation

- git config --get core.hooksPath returns .githooks
- Stage a file containing a fake key matching the hook's own pattern shapes and confirm git commit is rejected, then unstage it

## Scope

Local git configuration and setup-script wiring only.

findings.title: A GitHub credential was passed into agent session context instead of a controlled route
findings.reason: Fact: in the Qoder session lane (provider-labelled), one episode's request context contained a personal access token handoff together with the account identity; the collector redacted the value, which confirms it entered the session stream and persists in session history. The project's hook comment cites a server-side push-protection block on 2026-09-21, showing controlled secret incidents are already a known class here. Consequence: the credential left any controlled store, no revocation or rotation is recorded in the evidence, and session history retains the exposure surface. Uncertainty: whether the token was ever valid beyond the incident is not observable from this lane. Eligibility: this is an observed credential-crossing-boundary event, not a hypothetical risk.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Runbook owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

A GitHub credential was passed into agent session context. Prerequisite requiring explicit user authorization (external write): revoke or rotate the affected token at the credential provider. Then, using routes already present in this environment — gh auth login is declared in .githooks/pre-commit as the push-protection-friendly replacement — move any remaining secret usage into tracked configuration out of chat and session history. Do not paste raw tokens into prompts; state the handoff route in the project setup documentation.

## Validation

- Confirm the old token is revoked or rotated (provider-side, authorized by the user)
- Confirm a push from this workspace authenticates via the controlled route without a raw token in any prompt or committed file

## Scope

Credential hygiene only; no repository secret values are written into report or documentation.

findings.title: Two enabled plugin sources ship the same better-harness name with divergent versions
findings.reason: Fact: the deterministic asset-integrity envelope (status reviewed, findingCount 1) reports a name-collision group: better-harness@qoder-bundler 0.2.9 and better-harness@qoder-marketplace 0.2.21 are both enabled with the same canonical name. Consequence: for a skill routed by name, the active owner is ambiguous, and the reviewed versions differ. Confidence: high for the collision fact; low for which copy actually resolves — runtime resolution state is not in the envelopes, and confirming ownership needs authority to open user-home marketplace metadata, which this scope did not grant. This is ordinary Low governance, not a proven runtime failure.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Config owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Two enabled plugin sources ship the same better-harness name with divergent versions. Bounded discovery: from plugin management metadata visible in this environment (Qoder plugin/marketplace management), determine which source resolves as active for the better-harness skill today. Then keep exactly one source enabled — disabling or uninstalling a plugin is a separate explicitly authorized action; do not delete cache directories. Record the chosen owner next to the decision.

## Validation

- Re-run the bounded asset-integrity check and confirm the name-collision group is gone
- Confirm /better-harness still invokes the retained copy

## Scope

Plugin enablement state only; no plugin file contents modified.

findings.title: Learning-capture review cannot decide whether work is repeated
findings.reason: Fact: 36 of 39 admitted session episodes carry no recoverable request boundary (noRequest), only 2 of 6 enabled session source roots exist (warnings: disabled-source-root, missing-optional-root), and the single emitted request root sits in one context group, so the repeated-workflow clustering produced zero surviving candidates and the recurrence question is blocked at the observation boundary. The workflow-demand lane confirms recurrence assessment ended at insufficient-episodes rather than a clean no-candidate window. Consequence: reusable-improvement demand can neither be established nor ruled out this window, and native/skills candidates stay unrouted leads. This is the model-required evidence-gap disposition under lifecycle-repeat-detection; it is not a claim that repetition does or does not exist. Falsifier of any future repeat claim remains unavailable until episode boundaries recover.
expectedOutput: Update the existing Document owner identified by the reviewed evidence and retain a focused validation result.
findings.aiFixPrompt:
/better-harness fix this issue

Learning-capture review cannot decide whether work is repeated. Widen the bounded evidence honestly: rerun the /better-harness evidence bundle for the qoder provider on this workspace with an explicitly authorized window and, if the user authorizes it, session sources that restore request boundaries; record which of the 6 enabled roots resolve. Do not treat the 36 noRequest episodes as either repetition or a clean window, and do not create any Skill or Memory from this gap.

## Validation

- The rerun bundle reports admitted episodes with usable request boundaries, or the report states the named unavailable roots explicitly
- A subsequent recurrence decision is possible, or the outcome is an explicit adequate clean no-candidate window

## Scope

Evidence collection only; read-only with respect to the project.
